```{r}
#| title: Data Import & Cleaning

# Load the single master dataset containing all configurations
master_raw <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "02_master_sample_table-9s.rds"))

# Isolate the post-treatment period (2023) and split Match_Type into Algorithm and Ratio
master_comp_post <- master_raw %>%
  filter(Year == 2023) %>%
  mutate(
    Algorithm = case_when(
      grepl("Mahalanobis", Match_Type) ~ "Mahalanobis",
      grepl("Logit", Match_Type) ~ "Logit",
      grepl("CEM", Match_Type) ~ "CEM"
    ),
    Ratio = case_when(
      grepl("1:1", Match_Type) ~ "1:1 Ratio",
      grepl("1:3", Match_Type) ~ "1:3 Ratio",
      TRUE ~ "CEM"
    )
  )

```

```{r}
#| title: Reshaping for Analysis

# Define alpha for significance
alpha_level <- 0.10

# A. Ratio Comparison Data (Flagging 1:1 vs 1:3 significance)
ratio_data <- master_comp_post %>%
  filter(Algorithm %in% c("Mahalanobis", "Logit")) %>%
  select(Strata, Algorithm, Ratio, DiD_Ext_Estimate, DiD_Ext_PValue) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Ratio,
    values_from = c(DiD_Ext_Estimate, DiD_Ext_PValue),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{Ratio}"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Estimate_1 = `DiD_Ext_Estimate_1:1 Ratio`,
    Estimate_3 = `DiD_Ext_Estimate_1:3 Ratio`,
    PValue_1 = `DiD_Ext_PValue_1:1 Ratio`,
    PValue_3 = `DiD_Ext_PValue_1:3 Ratio`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Abs_Diff_Ext = Estimate_3 - Estimate_1,
    Pct_Diff_Ext = (Abs_Diff_Ext / Estimate_1) * 100,
    
    Sig_1 = PValue_1 < alpha_level,
    Sig_3 = PValue_3 < alpha_level,
    Significance = case_when(
      Sig_1 & Sig_3   ~ "Significant in Both",
      !Sig_1 & !Sig_3 ~ "Not Significant",
      Sig_1 & !Sig_3  ~ "Significant only in 1:1",
      !Sig_1 & Sig_3  ~ "Significant only in 1:3"
    ),
    Significance = factor(Significance, levels = c("Significant in Both", "Significant only in 1:3", "Significant only in 1:1", "Not Significant"))
  )

# B. Algorithm Comparison Data (Pairwise Combinations)
# Isolate CEM as the static baseline
cem_data <- master_comp_post %>%
  filter(Algorithm == "CEM") %>%
  select(Strata, Estimate_CEM = DiD_Ext_Estimate, PValue_CEM = DiD_Ext_PValue)

# Isolate Nearest Neighbor (NN) data
nn_data <- master_comp_post %>% filter(Algorithm %in% c("Mahalanobis", "Logit"))

# 1. Logit vs Mahalanobis
algo_log_mah <- nn_data %>%
  select(Strata, Algorithm, Ratio, DiD_Ext_Estimate, DiD_Ext_PValue) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Algorithm, values_from = c(DiD_Ext_Estimate, DiD_Ext_PValue), names_glue = "{.value}_{Algorithm}") %>%
  mutate(
    Abs_Diff_Algo = DiD_Ext_Estimate_Mahalanobis - DiD_Ext_Estimate_Logit,
    Sig_Logit = DiD_Ext_PValue_Logit < alpha_level,
    Sig_Mahal = DiD_Ext_PValue_Mahalanobis < alpha_level,
    Significance = case_when(
      Sig_Logit & Sig_Mahal   ~ "Significant in Both",
      !Sig_Logit & !Sig_Mahal ~ "Not Significant",
      Sig_Logit & !Sig_Mahal  ~ "Significant only in Logit",
      !Sig_Logit & Sig_Mahal  ~ "Significant only in Mahalanobis"
    ),
    Significance = factor(Significance, levels = c("Significant in Both", "Significant only in Mahalanobis", "Significant only in Logit", "Not Significant"))
  )

# 2. Logit vs CEM
algo_log_cem <- nn_data %>% 
  filter(Algorithm == "Logit") %>%
  left_join(cem_data, by = "Strata") %>%
  mutate(
    Abs_Diff_Algo = Estimate_CEM - DiD_Ext_Estimate,
    Sig_Logit = DiD_Ext_PValue < alpha_level,
    Sig_CEM = PValue_CEM < alpha_level,
    Significance = case_when(
      Sig_Logit & Sig_CEM   ~ "Significant in Both",
      !Sig_Logit & !Sig_CEM ~ "Not Significant",
      Sig_Logit & !Sig_CEM  ~ "Significant only in Logit",
      !Sig_Logit & Sig_CEM  ~ "Significant only in CEM"
    ),
    Significance = factor(Significance, levels = c("Significant in Both", "Significant only in CEM", "Significant only in Logit", "Not Significant"))
  )

# 3. Mahalanobis vs CEM
algo_mah_cem <- nn_data %>% 
  filter(Algorithm == "Mahalanobis") %>%
  left_join(cem_data, by = "Strata") %>%
  mutate(
    Abs_Diff_Algo = Estimate_CEM - DiD_Ext_Estimate,
    Sig_Mahal = DiD_Ext_PValue < alpha_level,
    Sig_CEM = PValue_CEM < alpha_level,
    Significance = case_when(
      Sig_Mahal & Sig_CEM   ~ "Significant in Both",
      !Sig_Mahal & !Sig_CEM ~ "Not Significant",
      Sig_Mahal & !Sig_CEM  ~ "Significant only in Mahalanobis",
      !Sig_Mahal & Sig_CEM  ~ "Significant only in CEM"
    ),
    Significance = factor(Significance, levels = c("Significant in Both", "Significant only in CEM", "Significant only in Mahalanobis", "Not Significant"))
  )

```


```{r}
#| title: Numerical Diagnostics (RMSE & Divergence Summaries)

# Quantify how much 1:3 drifts from 1:1, separated by matching algorithm
ratio_summary <- ratio_data %>%
  group_by(Algorithm) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Estimate_1 = mean(Estimate_1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Estimate_3 = mean(Estimate_3, na.rm = TRUE),
    RMSE_Ratio      = sqrt(mean(Abs_Diff_Ext^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Max_Abs_Drift   = max(abs(Abs_Diff_Ext), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print("--- Stability Across Ratios (1:1 vs 1:3) ---")
print(ratio_summary)

```

```{r}
#| title: Visualizations
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

# Define a custom color palette for significance states
sig_colors <- c(
  "Significant in Both" = "#27ae60",             # Green
  "Significant only in 1:3" = "#d35400",         # Orange
  "Significant only in 1:1" = "#f39c12",         # Yellow
  "Significant only in Mahalanobis" = "#9b59b6", # Purple
  "Significant only in Logit" = "#e74c3c",       # Red
  "Significant only in CEM" = "#2980b9",         # Blue
  "Not Significant" = "#bdc3c7"                  # Gray
)

# Base theme
theme_jade <- theme_light() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", color = "white"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#2c3e50"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# Plot A: Ratio Stability (Faceted by Algorithm, Colored by Significance)
p_ratio <- ggplot(ratio_data, aes(x = Estimate_1, y = Estimate_3, 
                                  color = Significance, shape = Significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 3) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sig_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 15, 1)) + 
  facet_wrap(~Algorithm) +
  labs(
    title = "Estimate Stability (2023): 1:1 vs 1:3 Matching Ratio",
    subtitle = "Dashed line denotes perfect agreement. Colors map to p < 0.10",
    x = "External DiD Estimate (1:1)",
    y = "External DiD Estimate (1:3)",
    color = "Significance (p < 0.10)",
    shape = "Significance (p < 0.10)"
  ) +
  theme_jade

# Plot B1: Algorithm Stability - Logit vs Mahalanobis
p_algo_log_mah <- ggplot(algo_log_mah, aes(x = DiD_Ext_Estimate_Logit, y = DiD_Ext_Estimate_Mahalanobis, 
                                color = Significance, shape = Significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 3) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sig_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 15, 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~Ratio) +
  labs(
    title = "Algorithm Consistency (2023): Logit vs Mahalanobis",
    subtitle = "Dashed line denotes perfect agreement. Colors map to p < 0.10",
    x = "External DiD Estimate (Logit)",
    y = "External DiD Estimate (Mahalanobis)",
    color = "Significance (p < 0.10)",
    shape = "Significance (p < 0.10)"
  ) +
  theme_jade

# Plot B2: Algorithm Stability - Logit vs CEM
p_algo_log_cem <- ggplot(algo_log_cem, aes(x = DiD_Ext_Estimate, y = Estimate_CEM, 
                                color = Significance, shape = Significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 3) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sig_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 15, 17, 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~Ratio) +
  labs(
    title = "Algorithm Consistency (2023): Logit vs CEM",
    subtitle = "Dashed line denotes perfect agreement. Colors map to p < 0.10",
    x = "External DiD Estimate (Logit)",
    y = "External DiD Estimate (CEM)",
    color = "Significance (p < 0.10)",
    shape = "Significance (p < 0.10)"
  ) +
  theme_jade

# Plot B3: Algorithm Stability - Mahalanobis vs CEM
p_algo_mah_cem <- ggplot(algo_mah_cem, aes(x = DiD_Ext_Estimate, y = Estimate_CEM, 
                                color = Significance, shape = Significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 3) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sig_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 15, 17, 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~Ratio) +
  labs(
    title = "Algorithm Consistency (2023): Mahalanobis vs CEM",
    subtitle = "Dashed line denotes perfect agreement. Colors map to p < 0.10",
    x = "External DiD Estimate (Mahalanobis)",
    y = "External DiD Estimate (CEM)",
    color = "Significance (p < 0.10)",
    shape = "Significance (p < 0.10)"
  ) +
  theme_jade

# Render plots
print(p_ratio)
print(p_algo_log_mah)
print(p_algo_log_cem)
print(p_algo_mah_cem)

```

```{r}
#| label: build-and-export-gt-table
#| message: false
#| warning: false


# 1. Prepare data, define ordering, calculate sample sizes, and flag max values
did_results_df <- master_table %>%
  filter(Year == 2023) %>%
  mutate(
    # Baseline total N for the Strata group label
    Strata_Total_N = N_Pre_Controle + N_Pre_Tratado,
    Strata = paste0(Strata, " (Sample size = ", Strata_Total_N, ")"),
    
    # Post-matched total N for each specific algorithm row
    Matched_n = N_Post_Controle + N_Post_Tratado
  ) %>%
  select(Strata, Match_Type, Matched_n,
         DiD_Ext_Estimate, DiD_Ext_SE, DiD_Ext_PValue, 
         DiD_Int_Estimate, DiD_Int_SE, DiD_Int_PValue) %>%
  mutate(
    Match_Type = factor(Match_Type, levels = c(
      "CEM", 
      "Logit (1:1)", "Logit (1:3)", 
      "Mahalanobis (1:1)", "Mahalanobis (1:3)"
    ))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Strata, Match_Type) %>%
  group_by(Strata) %>%
  mutate(
    max_ext_est = DiD_Ext_Estimate == max(DiD_Ext_Estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_ext_se  = DiD_Ext_SE == max(DiD_Ext_SE, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_int_est = DiD_Int_Estimate == max(DiD_Int_Estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_int_se  = DiD_Int_SE == max(DiD_Int_SE, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. Build the gt table
did_results_table <- did_results_df %>%
  group_by(Strata) %>% 
  gt() %>%
  cols_hide(columns = c(max_ext_est, max_ext_se, max_int_est, max_int_se)) %>%
  
  # Headers
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Difference-in-Differences Estimates (2023)**"),
    subtitle = "Causal Impact of Line 13 - Jade across Matching Algorithms"
  ) %>%
  
  # Spanners
  tab_spanner(
    label = md("**Extensive Margin** (Probability of Trip)"),
    columns = c(DiD_Ext_Estimate, DiD_Ext_SE, DiD_Ext_PValue)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = md("**Intensive Margin** (Trip Volume)"),
    columns = c(DiD_Int_Estimate, DiD_Int_SE, DiD_Int_PValue)
  ) %>%
  
  # Column Labels
  cols_label(
    Match_Type = "Matching Method",
    Matched_n = "Matched n",
    DiD_Ext_Estimate = "Estimate",
    DiD_Ext_SE = "SE",
    DiD_Ext_PValue = "p-value",
    DiD_Int_Estimate = "Estimate",
    DiD_Int_SE = "SE",
    DiD_Int_PValue = "p-value"
  ) %>%
  
  # Number Formatting
  fmt_number(
    columns = Matched_n,
    decimals = 0,
    use_seps = TRUE
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(DiD_Ext_Estimate, DiD_Ext_SE, DiD_Int_Estimate, DiD_Int_SE),
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(DiD_Ext_PValue, DiD_Int_PValue),
    decimals = 4
  ) %>%
  
  # Highlight significant P-Values (p < 0.10)
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "#27ae60"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = DiD_Ext_PValue, rows = DiD_Ext_PValue < 0.10)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "#27ae60"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = DiD_Int_PValue, rows = DiD_Int_PValue < 0.10)
  ) %>%
  
  # Bold maximum estimates and SEs per strata
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = DiD_Ext_Estimate, rows = max_ext_est)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = DiD_Ext_SE, rows = max_ext_se)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = DiD_Int_Estimate, rows = max_int_est)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = DiD_Int_SE, rows = max_int_se)
  ) %>%
  
  # Aesthetics
  opt_align_table_header(align = "left") %>%
  tab_options(
    row_group.font.weight = "bold",
    row_group.background.color = "#f4f4f4"
  )

# Render the table in the Quarto document
did_results_table

# 3. Export Artifacts
gtsave(did_results_table, filename = here("outputs", "tables", "04_did_results_table.png"))
gtsave(did_results_table, filename = here("outputs", "tables", "04_did_results_table.html"))

# Export the raw metrics as a CSV (dropping the boolean formatting flags)
write_csv(
  did_results_df %>% select(-starts_with("max_")), 
  here("outputs", "tables", "04_did_results_metrics.csv")
)

```
